result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: critical low-contrast promo banner text that is nearly invisible, bottom popular card clipped behind the tab bar, and blurry thumbnails in the fastest section.

issues.description: Promotional banner text '3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout' is white on a very light mint background and is almost unreadable due to insufficient contrast.
issues.suggestion: Increase text contrast by using a dark green text color on the light background or darken the banner background color to meet WCAG contrast requirements

issues.description: Second card under 'Popular right now' (pizza with -20% badge) is clipped and obscured by the bottom tab bar, with no restaurant name, rating or delivery info visible and no spacing above navigation.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding and safe-area inset so scroll content stops above the tab bar and cards are fully viewable

issues.description: Thumbnail images in 'Fastest near you' row appear blurry/low-resolution, especially backgrounds, making cards look unfinished compared to sharper illustrations below.
issues.suggestion: Replace with higher-resolution assets and ensure proper image compression and sizing for card thumbnails
